content.title: Knicks vs. Rockets Prediction, Spread, NBA Picks for Tuesday, March 31
content.text: The New York Knicks (48-27) are 1.5-point favorites on the spread vs. the Houston Rockets (45-29) for tonight’s game at 8:00 p.m. ET on NBC and Peacock. Both teams still have plenty left to play for as they try to improve their respective playoff seeds.Below, we’ll break down our Knicks vs. Rockets prediction and picks for Tuesday night’s game. He's been mired in a shooting slump, making only 34.4% of his field goal attempts since the All-Star break.When these two teams played in New York in February, the Knicks won 108-106 despite Rockets F Kevin Durant pouring in 30 points.Knicks vs. Rockets Picks for PrizePicks Today: 3/31/26Here are top Knicks vs. Rockets picks to target for Tuesday, March 31, on PrizePicks. Today’s NBA picks for PrizePicks are headlined by Rockets C Alperen Sengun and Knicks PF OG Anunoby.Rockets C Alperen Sengun vs. Knicks Projection: 5.5 AssistsSengun averages 6.2 assists per game for the season, but that number is 6.7 over the last six since Eason was benched.With the Rockets focusing on preparing for the postseason, Sengun has averaged 35 minutes and 7.1 assists over their last seven games.The Knicks allow 24.9 assists per game for the season but have given up 26.9 dimes a night across their last 10.In the previous meeting between these teams, Sengun recorded 6 assists over 31 minutes.Knicks PF OG Anunoby vs. Rockets Projection: 15.5 PointsAnunoby continues to be an efficient scorer, shooting 48.6% from the field, 38.1% from behind the arc, and 81.8% at the free throw line.Despite playing four fewer minutes per game than last season, the veteran forward still averages 16.7 points.Anunoby puts up 17.7 PPG on the road compared to 15.8 at home.The former Toronto Raptor went 8-for-16 from the field on his way to scoring 20 points against the Rockets in their last meeting.Rockets PG Amen Thompson vs. Knicks Projection: 7.5 ReboundsRockets PG Amen Thompson plays a ton, averaging 37 minutes a game.
